# An android field commits through its own path: the focus leaving it, and an
# input's keyboard Done or hardware Enter, each committing only an edit made
# since the last commit, and then submitting. A field removed while focused
# commits nothing, as html's removed input fires no change. A test moves the
# focus to another field, presses the keyboard's action and a hardware key, as
# a user does. Only android, whose commit is this path; the change trigger
# every target answers is program_write_fires_no_event_runs.txt's.

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   9 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin keys.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var text = ""
    var memo = ""
    var away = ""
    var gone = ""
    var changes = 0
    var order = ""
    var show = true

    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #field(
            :value = text,
            @change(v) {
                changes += 1
                order = order + "c"
            },
            @submit {
                order = order + "s"
            },
        )
        ui.textarea #notes(:value=memo, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
        ui.input #other(:value=away)
        ui.button #set(text="set", @click {
            text = "abc"
            memo = "abc"
        })
        if show {
            ui.input #leaving(:value=gone, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
        }
        ui.button #hide(text="hide", @click { show = false })
    }
}

func testFocusNoEditBlurFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.other.focus()
    c.notes.focus()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testFocusEditBlurFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.notes.focus()
    c.notes.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 2)
}

func testProgramWriteThenBlurFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.set.click()
    c.other.focus()
    c.notes.focus()
    c.set.click()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.text == "abc")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testDoneThenBlurFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

func testChangeTriggerThenBlurFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.notes.focus()
    c.notes.input("xy")
    c.notes.change("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

func testDoneUneditedFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testDoneCommitsThenSubmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.order == "cs")
}

func testDoneUneditedSubmitsAlone(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.order == "s")
}

func testRemovedWhileEditedFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    if c.leaving != null {
        c.leaving.focus()
        c.leaving.input("xy")
    }
    c.hide.click()
    t.assert(c.gone == "xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- keys.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component app root {
    var text = ""
    var order = ""

    ui.window #main(title="Keys", @key(e, stop) {}) {
        ui.input #line(:value=text, @change(v) { order = order + "c" }, @submit { order = order + "s" })
    }
}

app()

func testEnterCommitsAndSubmits(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.line.focus()
    c.main.key(ui.KeyPress{key="h", editing=true}, func() {})
    c.main.key(ui.KeyPress{key="i", editing=true}, func() {})
    c.main.key(ui.KeyPress{key="Enter", editing=true}, func() {})
    t.assert(c.text == "hi")
    t.assert(c.order == "cs")
}
